published_stasis.status: published phase description, scale and model dependent

climate_source.version: Author-hosted LR04 stack, updated August 1, 2005: removed age rounding at 3.0-1.5 Ma; added 0.64 cib. correction
climate_source.age_model: Published LR04 graphic correlation and orbitally tuned age model with sedimentation-rate constraints; no retuning or resampling
climate_source.signal: Benthic oxygen isotope stack: global ice volume and deep-ocean temperature, not direct air temperature

events.label: Middle Pleistocene Transition
events.date_meaning: approximate conventional transition boundaries, not a confidence interval
events.interpretation_limit: Longer and stronger glacial cycles developed across a transition; these boundaries do not date a single catastrophe.

events.label: MIS 34 cooling
events.geography: North Atlantic and southwest European proxy records
events.date_meaning: climate interval on the study age model, not a confidence interval
events.interpretation_limit: European hominin depopulation is a demographic inference from proxy, habitat-model and occupation evidence; not a measured global extinction or ancestral bottleneck.

events.label: MIS 34 terminal stadial
events.evidence_status: extreme terminal cooling in proxy records
events.date_meaning: stadial duration on the study age model, not dating error
events.interpretation_limit: Nested within MIS34; the regional demographic inference remains distinct from the environmental observation.

events.label: Ancestral bottleneck (disputed)
events.geography: Proposed ancestral population of modern humans
events.date_meaning: model-inferred demographic duration, not a confidence interval
events.effective_size_meaning: genetic-model effective population size, not a census of surviving humans
events.interpretation_limit: FitCoal inference is contested by statistical-artifact and insufficient-fit critiques. The 2026 methodological defense does not establish consensus. Muttoni and Kent's 2024 MIS22 migration/timing interpretation is distinct from MIS34 cooling near 1.1 Ma.

events.label: Australasian impact
events.geography: Australasian tektite field; proposed Bolaven source in Laos
events.evidence_status: established impact evidence; source-location interpretation contested
events.date_meaning: rounded event age; reported analytical age errors below are separate from event duration

reported_uncertainty.convention: 2 sigma, explicitly stated in SI Table S1 and tektite-dating discussion
quoted plus/minus value for prior published mean; confidence convention not restated in the comparison paragraph
quoted plus/minus value after common standard-age and decay-constant recalibration; no conversion to a confidence interval
quoted plus/minus value for inverse-variance combined mean; not event duration; comparison paragraph does not separately restate sigma convention

events.interpretation_limit: Tektite evidence establishes an impact. Bolaven source arguments and biological consequences require separate assessment; no verified evidence here establishes a cause of cranial-volume stasis.

dating_source_audit.page_note: SI Table S1 p2 labels plateau ages plus/minus 2 sigma. SI tektite-dating discussion explicitly calls 788.9+/-2.4 ka 2 sigma. The article main text calls the prior date a five-tektite mean; the SI says nine. We retain the date without asserting a reconciled prior specimen count.
